candidates.change_summary: Delete the low-level call to target so no external call is made, leaving funds in the contract to be transferred to owner.
Replace the target address with a different address so funds are sent to a different contract.
Replace the transfer call with a selfdestruct to owner so the contract is destroyed instead of just transferring balance.
Replace the recipient of the transfer with msg.sender instead of owner so funds go to caller.
Delete the transfer to owner so funds remain locked in the contract.
Replace value: msg.value with value: 0 so no ether is forwarded to target.
